Patat2006.pages: Published pp387 section3 calibration; pp387-389 section4 and Table1 fit; pp389-390 Fig10 station comparison; p391 section5 and appendix assumptions; p393 A.5 night emission addition.
Patat2006.observable: Total observed Johnson-Cousins V surface brightness, no documented astronomical night-background subtraction; sky selection within 40 degrees zenith distance for polynomial.
Patat2006.axis: Solar true/apparent and centre/upper-limb convention not explicitly locked down by paper. Do not infer from fit agreement.

Patat2003.note: 2000-2001 night sample, not simultaneous twilight baseline; the minus12 dark-fraction example is not a matched measured subtraction.

Koomen1952.pages: p353 instrument/calibration/site conditions; p354 TablesI/II and solar altitude definition; p355 smoothed-observation discussion.
Koomen1952.observable: Photopic-intended green-filter photomultiplier,1.5deg FoV; smoothed station observations,not a controlled altitude intervention.
Koomen1952.axis: Only solar altitude relative to horizon given; true/apparent and centre/limb unspecified.
Koomen1952.late_twilight_caveat: Authors mention unapplied photometric correction below .003 candle/ft2, without a quantified error budget. Minus6 zenith values exceed this threshold.

ESO_BESS_V.response_limit: Filter only; no old FORS1 TK2048 QE, optics or standard-star transformation. Use 380-780nm only for these model spectra. Not the 2007 HIGH filter series.

CALSPEC_Vega.note: Current ETC table uses version012. Adopting V=.031 with fixed011 defines an explicit approximation,not reconstruction of Patat historical zero points.

AB.response_definition: Integrate photon counts lambda*Llambda*T dlambda; independent frequency-domain check uses fnu*T/nu dnu.

results.scope_limit: Only clear-scene solar elevation minus6 degrees; does not determine a causal altitude response or band correction at minus9/minus12.
